B.what: stage 1 of research/operators/qwen_deltanet_m2_build (stage1.cpp included unchanged), split into prover and verifier processes (phase_b.cpp)
B.statement: one Qwen Gated DeltaNet head, D = 128, T = 4 positions, F = 12 fixed point, public head output o, no conv, no norm; synthetic inputs
B.arithmetic_policy: BLK_FIELD=2, BLK_HASH=1, research security (target 10 bits, N = 10 combinations, toy coins); not a production soundness level
B.context_output_lengths: T = 4 head positions per statement, each with a proved output o_t; no prompt/generation split
B.coverage: the one head's recurrence and output for all 4 positions; not in_proj, out_proj, norms, MLP, other heads or layers
B.batch: 1 statement per proof; amortized cell = 4 statements per prover process and per verifier process
B.fixtures: research/operators/qwen_deltanet/reference.py write_fixture, seeds 1..10, SHA-256 equal to research/operators/qwen_deltanet_m2_build/evidence.json stage1_fixtures (runs/fixtures.json)
B.seeds: cold rep i: seed i+1; amortized rep i: seeds ((i+j) mod 10)+1 for j = 0..3
